test_title: RRB ALP CBT-II (Mechanic Diesel) Official Paper (Held On: 06 May, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Diesel fuel is generally used in which of the following types of vehicles?
solution:
The correct answer is __Heavy trucks and buses**(Option 2)**.__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Diesel fuel__ is primarily used in heavy-duty vehicles.
 
• Examples include trucks, buses, and construction machinery.
 
• Diesel engines are preferred for their efficiency and durability in transporting heavy loads.
 
• They are designed for long-distance and high-performance operations.
 
• Diesel engines produce higher torque and are more fuel-efficient compared to gasoline engines.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Gasoline Engines:**
 
 
• Primarily used in cars, motorcycles, and light-duty vehicles.
 
• They are more suitable for short-distance travel and have lower torque output.
 
 
 
• **Electric Vehicles:**
 
 
• Electric vehicles run on battery-powered electric motors.
 
• They are eco-friendly and ideal for reducing carbon emissions but have limitations in range and charging infrastructure.
 
 
 
• **Hybrid Vehicles:**
 
 
• Combine electric motors and internal combustion engines for enhanced efficiency.
 
• Used in cars and SUVs for better fuel economy and reduced emissions.
